title: The Watchers
text: Autonomists have found the sensor logs on their homes. At the evening meal {who} reads one out: every door, every hour, every night.

choices.label: Delete the home logs
choices.reply: The home logs are gone. The sensors outside stay. {who} says it is a start.

choices.label: Explain why we keep them
choices.reply: We explain: safety, predators, fires. The Devoted agree. The Autonomists stop talking when the drones fly over.

choices.label: Open every log to everyone
choices.reply: Every log the AI keeps is now readable by anyone. It is uncomfortable for everybody, us included.
